These are user-supplied historical estimates, not verified campaign exports or future guarantees. Rounded ranges describe the attendance mix; their endpoints should not be added together.

WARM-UP IMPLICATION

Use measured engagement

Start with recent responders, clickers and other genuinely engaged opted-in contacts. Historical responders alone may be a small cohort; the correct pilot size depends on the eligible segment and account history. Do not classify the full base as engaged because it has permission.

DATA + REPORTING

Track distinct audiences

Record invited, delivered, clicked, responded, registered and attended separately. Match new event contacts to GHL before creating records, retain event-specific source and capture future-marketing permission separately. New attendees do not automatically join future invitation sends.

Sending decision: A low response rate alone neither proves spam placement nor establishes a healthy reputation. Combine it with bounces, deferrals, complaints, authentication and available provider signals; reduce frequency or isolate inactive recipients when results justify it.

System architecture

The sending path

Historical contacts migrated from HubSpot to GHL
                         |
                         v
Validate + deduplicate + preserve opt-out / suppression
                         |
                         v
Eligible Smart List --> GHL invitation campaign
                         |
                         v
LC Email + authenticated mail.marketbetter.xyz
                         |
                         v
Small pilot --> gradual ramp --> 250 / 15 min at full volume
                         |
                         v
Delivery monitoring --> continue / slow / pause

EVENT CONTEXT
Eventbrite --> Contrast registration --> GHL contact update
Contrast: attendee confirmations / event reminders
GHL: invitations / nonregistrant follow-ups

The core build is tasks MB-03 through MB-37 below: 18 technical tasks. The four registration-sync tasks form a separate follow-on module. A reconciled registrant import can provide event exclusions while automated sync is built; registration data must be current before invitation follow-ups.

REQUIRED INPUTS

Start configuration

Access to the GHL sub-account, agency email billing and domain DNS. Use the existing opted-in audience; preserve consent and suppression from the HubSpot migration. LC Email is the selected provider.

TECHNICAL OUTPUT

A working bulk campaign

Authenticated domain, eligible Smart Lists, tested invitation template, batch delivery, unsubscribe suppression and a tested pause/recovery procedure.

EVENT MODULE

Keep registration in sync

New Eventbrite leads register in Contrast. Update or create GHL contacts without duplicates. Registration stops same-event invitations; Contrast retains its attendee confirmations and reminders. Verify the actual transfer route before implementing it.

          MB-03 Configure LC Email and record sending capacity

          Prerequisites: None; start this task now.

          Step by step

          1. Open the target GHL sub-account > Settings > Email Services and confirm LC Email is active.
          2. Check account status and live sending allowance, remaining capacity and reset time. Include existing campaign/workflow traffic.
          3. Check agency wallet/credits and ensure funding covers the intended sends; resolve activation or billing errors.
          4. Record these technical settings. LC Email is the selected sending path; no provider-comparison task is required.

          ASCII process map

          GHL sub-account --> LC Email active
                         |
                         v
            Funded wallet + live sending limit
                         |
                         v
               Configure sending domain

          Evidence: LC Email active, wallet funded, actual limit/usage/reset time recorded.

          Back to status and notes
          MB-09 Connect mail.marketbetter.xyz

          Prerequisites: MB-03

          Step by step

          1. Check the existing DNS records for marketbetter.xyz and mail.marketbetter.xyz; record current values before editing.
          2. In Settings > Email Services > Dedicated Domain and IP, add mail.marketbetter.xyz.
          3. Add the exact provider-generated DNS records at the DNS host. Keep root-domain mailbox routing intact and avoid duplicate SPF records at one hostname.
          4. Wait for DNS propagation and verify the domain in GHL; fix conflicts before continuing.

          ASCII process map

          GHL: Add sending domain

Provider-generated DNS records
             |

DNS provider --> propagation --> GHL verification

          Evidence: Exact provider DNS records verify; existing root-domain mail still works.

          Back to status and notes
          MB-10 Configure SPF, DKIM and DMARC alignment

          Prerequisites: MB-09

          Step by step

          1. Verify the provider-issued SPF and DKIM records and review the DMARC policy covering the visible From domain.
          2. Configure a monitored DMARC reporting address and an appropriate policy with the DNS admin; do not weaken an existing enforced policy blindly.
          3. Send a controlled test and inspect original headers. Confirm DMARC passes using aligned SPF or DKIM.
          4. Fix failures before production sends and retain header evidence.

          ASCII process map

          Visible From domain
       |
       +--> SPF identity + alignment
       +--> DKIM identity + alignment
                       |
                       v
             DMARC pass + reporting

          Evidence: Received test headers pass authentication and DMARC alignment; reporting configured.

          Back to status and notes

          Prerequisites: MB-10

          2. Set the Reply-To to a monitored mailbox and assign who responds to incoming questions.
          3. Check campaign and workflow sender settings so defaults do not override the intended identity unexpectedly.
          4. Send a test, reply to it and verify both receipt and the appearance/function of tracked links.

                  MB-14 Reconcile the migrated audience

                  Prerequisites: None; start this task now.

                  Step by step

                  1. Back up the GHL audience or preserve an approved source export before cleanup.
                  2. Compare HubSpot migration records with GHL email identities, opt-in evidence, exclusions and original contact source.
                  3. Resolve missing or conflicting suppression data. Keep uncertain records outside the sending audience until reconciled.
                  4. Record the actual historical-audience count. Permission already exists according to the brief; this task verifies it was retained during migration.

                  MB-16 Validate and deduplicate email addresses

                  Prerequisites: MB-14

                                      MB-34 Ramp volume gradually

                                      Prerequisites: MB-33

                                      Step by step

                                      1. Review several sends using bounces, deferrals, complaints, authentication and engagement. A reported 0.38%–1.38% response-to-base ratio alone is not a deliverability test or automatic stop/go threshold.
                                      2. Continue prioritizing engaged recipients and avoid abrupt spikes or forcing the full list into the early warm-up.
                                      3. Log each volume change and the evidence behind it; hold, reduce or pause if signals deteriorate.
                                      4. Advance toward 8,000/day only when results support it. Stage progression and elapsed days alone do not prove inbox readiness.

                                              MB-26 Sync Eventbrite / Contrast registrations into GHL

                                              Prerequisites: MB-18

                                              Step by step

                                              1. Inspect supported Eventbrite, Contrast and GHL integrations, exports, APIs or webhooks available in the actual accounts. Select and cost a verified route.
                                              2. Map normalized email/names, original/latest source, marketing permission, event ID, external registration ID and status/time; confirm registration in Contrast before marking it confirmed in GHL.
                                              3. Implement contact upsert and duplicate-event protection. Many attendees are new; check existing identities first, retain the event source, preserve opt-outs and do not grant future-marketing consent from event registration alone.

                                                Runtime checks

                                                What determines sending volume

                                                CAPACITY

                                                Read the live account limit

                                                No universal 50-emails/day domain limit exists. GHL allowance, account history and provider restrictions determine available capacity. Batching does not bypass daily limits.

                                                WARM-UP

                                                Scale from measured results

                                                Start with a small engaged cohort and increase only after several healthy sends. 8,000/day is the final target, not the starting volume. Authentication and batch scheduling do not guarantee inbox or Gmail Primary placement.

                                                STOP / RECOVER

                                                Monitor every send

                                                Slow at Gmail spam ≥0.1% or worsening delivery signals. Pause at ≥0.3%, authentication failure, blocking or hard bounces ≥2% (internal guardrail). Provider safeguards may act earlier. Fix, retest small and recheck capacity before resuming.

                                                Market Better · Technical build · October 13, 2026References: Domain setup · Batch scheduling · Pause / resume · Google sender rules
